body: Social Security Act 2018 section 77 makes the principal caregiver or temporary OB or UCB caregiver of a dependent child eligible for childcare assistance at the prescribed rate if that caregiver meets the criteria and other requirements set out in regulations made under section 424.

Social Security Act 2018 section 424 authorises regulations for childcare assistance. Regulations may prescribe eligibility criteria, kinds and amounts of childcare assistance, income treatment, the number of hours a week for which childcare assistance is available, temporary-absence place keeping, applications, direct payment to facilities or programme providers, overpayment recovery, and transitional arrangements. Eligibility criteria may be based on caregiver and partner income, the child's age and school attendance, disability or serious illness of the child or caregiver or other dependent children, availability of another caregiver, and whether the caregiver is undertaking employment, an MSD-arranged or approved employment-related activity, an approved course of study, or an approved rehabilitation programme.
